## Product-source truth

The authoritative AgentSight repository still reports `v1.0.4` as the latest release. It was published on `2026-08-10` from product commit `ac1e6cb7a8398c57c1ad0ba04ff032cd271d99c8` and adds Cursor IDE session support through the agent-native local-session path.

The delivered Cursor page keeps the implementation boundary explicit:

- Cursor transcripts are read below `~/.cursor/projects/<workspace>/agent-transcripts/`;
- delegated `subagents/*.jsonl` work is folded into the parent session;
- local `state.vscdb` may enrich timing, model, and working-directory metadata but is optional;
- existing Cursor sessions are consumed through local-session commands such as `agentsight top`, `agentsight report --local`, and `agentsight vis`;
- no special Cursor launch and no eBPF sudo path is required for this agent-native source;
- live Cursor TLS/API-body capture is not claimed as supported;
- recent Cursor sessions may not expose local per-turn token totals, so missing token totals are a source limitation rather than proof of failed capture.

No broader Electron-IDE, macOS/Windows eBPF, customer, or benchmark claim was added.
